card.fires_on: Verbs, prepositions and possessives where a noun phrase naming a person, thing or amount must come next, in general web prose such as history, science or news. It also fires on a leading digit inside a year range.

modes.label: Possessive before a person
modes.description: A possessive such as their, his or your sits right before a person or relation noun.
modes.example: On 28 April, Hitler married<< his>> mistress, Eva Braun.

modes.label: Verb or preposition awaiting object
modes.description: A verb or preposition such as on, to, fly or draw that needs an object or destination next.
modes.example: GDP is the total amount of money spent<< on>> all final goods and services produced within a

modes.label: Year digit in a date range
modes.description: The leading digit of a year in a reign or date range.

card.writes: It suppresses words like someone and somebody, so the next word is less likely to be an indefinite person.
card.plain: It fires on small words that open a slot for a specific person or thing, so a vague 'someone' is not wanted there.
